title: Nitsum: Serving Tiered LLM Requests with Adaptive Tensor Parallelism
authors: Vikranth Srivatsa; Zijian He; Pu Guo; Dongming Li; Yiying Zhang
affiliations: University of California San Diego, GenseeAI Inc.
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Capacity planning

problem_statement.en: Production LLM clusters increasingly multiplex latency-critical interactive traffic with relaxed background workloads under a single fixed GPU budget, creating a tiered-SLO setting in which each request class carries distinct TTFT and TPOT targets. Workload mix, prompt and decode lengths, and load intensity all drift over time, so the per-request service time that determines SLO compliance is itself non-stationary; yet existing SLO-aware serving systems control only when a request runs (queuing, migration, autoscaling) while leaving the execution configuration — tensor-parallel degree, prefill/decode GPU split — fixed at deployment time, which structurally limits how far goodput can be improved.
problem_statement.zh: 生產級 LLM 叢集愈來愈須在固定 GPU 預算之下同時承擔延遲敏感的互動式請求與寬鬆的後台工作負載，形成多 SLO 階層情境，每一階層各有獨立的 TTFT 與 TPOT 目標。工作負載組成、prompt 與 decode 長度、以及負載強度均隨時間漂移，決定 SLO 達成率的單請求服務時間因此本身就是非穩態的；然而既有的 SLO 感知 serving 系統僅控制請求「何時」執行（排隊、遷移、自動擴縮），執行配置（張量並行度、prefill/decode GPU 分配）則在部署時固定，這在結構上限制了 goodput 可改善的上限。

key_innovation.en: Nitsum elevates tensor parallelism (TP) from a static deployment knob to a first-class runtime control surface and jointly optimizes TP level, prefill/decode GPU partition, and SLO-aware request scheduling on a sub-second control window. To make sub-second TP reconfiguration practical, it introduces (i) TP-aware weight reuse — one full weight copy per GPU plus warm pre-launched processes for every candidate TP level, eliminating the ~30 s weight redistribution of conventional TP-switching; and (ii) aggregated and pipelined KV migration with double-buffered coalescing of PagedAttention fragments, reducing migration latency by 245-376x versus cudaMemcpyAsync (3.6-24.8 ms for 0.5-5 GB of KV instead of 0.88-9.25 s).
key_innovation.zh: Nitsum 將張量並行度（TP）由部署時的靜態設定提升為一等公民的執行期控制面，並在不到一秒的控制窗格內同時調整 TP 層級、prefill/decode GPU 切割與 SLO 感知排程。為使次秒級 TP 重配置可行，其引入兩項機制：(i) TP 感知權重重用 — 每張 GPU 持有完整權重一份，並為每個候選 TP 層級預先啟動「保溫」進程，消除傳統 TP 切換約 30 秒的權重重分佈成本；(ii) 聚合且管線化的 KV 遷移 — 以雙緩衝聚合 PagedAttention 分頁碎片，相對 cudaMemcpyAsync 將遷移延遲降低 245-376 倍（0.5-5 GB KV 由 0.88-9.25 秒縮短至 3.6-24.8 毫秒）。

baselines_compared: Llumnix, Chiron, SGLang, SGLang-PD, Split (per-tier static-TP partition)

key_improvements.en: Up to 5.3x higher SLO-compliant goodput than the strongest baseline across A100/H100, 4/8-GPU clusters, Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen-14B, on both Azure production traces and ServeGen (Alibaba-calibrated). Near-linear scaling from 4 to 64 GPUs; baselines need 1.5-4x more GPUs to match. Ablation shows efficient TP switching is necessary — naive dynamic TP with cudaMemcpyAsync collapses goodput to zero.
key_improvements.zh: 在 A100/H100、4/8 GPU 叢集、Llama-3.1-8B 與 Qwen-14B、以及 Azure 生產 trace 與 ServeGen（依 Alibaba 校準）兩種工作負載下，相較最強基準提升至多 5.3 倍的 SLO 合規 goodput；自 4 GPU 擴至 64 GPU 接近線性，基準需 1.5-4 倍 GPU 數方能追平。Ablation 顯示高效 TP 切換是必要前提：以原生 cudaMemcpyAsync 實作的 naive 動態 TP 會使 goodput 崩至零。

traffic_pattern: Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, Continuous Batching
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 80GB, NVIDIA H100 80GB, NVIDIA B200 (profiling only)
comm_libraries: NCCL, custom KV-migration kernel (double-buffered pipelined coalesce)
gpu_count: 4x A100, 8x A100, 4x H100, 8x H100; scalability up to 64 GPUs
node_count: Single-node up to 8 GPUs per node; multi-node not reported in detail

source.extraction_notes: End-to-end testbed paper; built atop SGLang. Schema fields drawn from abstract, §1 motivation, §3 architecture, §5 mechanisms, §6 evaluation.
